context: Hello!
Hi, how are you?
Good amazing, how about you?
Good. I'm looking for some good movie recommendations. Do you have any?
Absolutely. Can you give me some examples of movies you watched and enjoyed?

Well the most recent movie I watched was Ex Machina. It was a sci-fi movie with a lot of deeper meanings. I have always liked movies that have to do with the future, especially ones that deal in psychology and human behavior.
Great movie! Are you more interested in newer movies, or no preference?
No preference, I like any movie with good writing. I also like movies that have many twists and turns.
Do you like movies with a lot of action in them, or one that are more focused on the story and build up of events?
I like ones that are more focused on the story and events. I like very complex storylines.
I think I have the perfect movie for you. Do you enjoy a movie that you want to re-watch after its over because the ending was so unexpected?
That sounds like the perfect movie, what is it?
I recommend the 2013 movie Coherence directed by James Ward Byrkit.
I have not heard of this one before. What is it about?

Its about a group of friends having a dinner party on the night of a comet passing over Earth. The comet starts to cause a lot of strange things to start happening. After watching it you will want to watch it again to pick up on all the things you learned at the end of the first watch!
Sounds like my kind of movie. Is it available to watch for free anywhere?
I believe it is on Hulu but I am not positive.
Ok thank you so much for the recommendation. I have hulu, so I will go and watch it now.
Perfect I hope you enjoy!
Are there any well known actors in it?
Surprisingly not. the main actors in this movie are: Emily Baldoni, Maury Sterling, Nicholas Brendon, Lorene Scafaria.
I have not heard of them, but I think it will still be fun to watch. Thanks again for the recommendation!

context.content: I am looking for a good restaurant to eat at in London.

Oh, I'm sorry, I'm more interested in finding a movie to watch. I love sci-fi and enjoy exploring unique stories. Do you have any recommendations? [END]
 Rejected the restaurant recommendation and explained the reason.
